usage:
Starts the Android emulator and returns once it has booted; says so if it is already on. Settings: avd (the emulator's name), port, memoryMb, window.
With the load gate (the load command found) it first makes room with `load room phone`, and does not start if there is not enough.
noAvd: No emulator set up yet: write modules.phone.avd in the instance config (the manual Phone/phone, its page installing-the-emulator)
booted: Booted ({serial}). The system is busy right after booting: wait half a minute before tapping apps
exited: The emulator quit by itself without booting; see {log}
wizardAbout: An Android emulator it can use apps on.
wizardHow: Needs the Android SDK and an emulator; then you log it in to the apps yourself.
